explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/645: in any 2-colouring of ℕ there is a monochromatic 3-AP x, x+d, x+2d with d > x (proved by Brown–Landman). The statement asserts this for every c : ℕ → Bool with 0 < x < d. The requirement x > 0 matches ℕ as the positive integers and avoids the degenerate x = 0. Faithful.
